segments.title: Gemini Gems become Skills
segments.say: Using Gemini Gems? They turn into Skills on November seventeenth.

segments.title: Type / to run one
segments.say: Skills are reusable instructions. Type a slash and the skill's name to run one.

segments.title: The dates
segments.say: November seventeenth, Gems go read only. December seventeenth, they're removed.

segments.title: Save big files first
segments.say: Google converts them for you, but download big knowledge files before then.
Save this before November seventeenth, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
